Code 
library(tidyverse)

library(scales)

library(sf)
library(tmap)

Code 
df_incubation <- read_xlsx(path = "../Data/Incubations_2025/Summer2025incubations_insolution_ppb.xlsx", sheet = "ppb_transposed")

Clean/tidy up the incubation data

Make a column with the name of the paddy the soil was sampled from

Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(Sample_ID = toupper(Sample_ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Location_ID = str_sub(Sample_ID, start = 1, end = 6))

Add a column with a flag indicating if the bottle is an experimental or control bottle

Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(EXP_CONTROL = if_else(str_detect(Sample_ID, "CONTROL"), "CONTROL", "EXPERIMENT"))

Add a column to indicate the incubation bottle number (e.g., 1,2,3) since each location has replicate bottles.

Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(Bottle_ID = case_when(EXP_CONTROL == "EXPERIMENT" & str_detect(Sample_ID, "VITAL", negate = T) ~ str_sub(Sample_ID, 8,8),
                               str_detect(Sample_ID, "CONTROL_") ~ "1",
                               str_detect(Sample_ID, "CONTROL1_") ~ "1",
                               str_detect(Sample_ID, "CONTROL2_") ~ "2",
                               str_detect(Sample_ID, "VITAL") ~ str_sub(Sample_ID, -1,-1)
    
  )
         )
Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(LOC_BOTTLE = paste(Location_ID, Bottle_ID, sep = "_"))
Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(Location_ID = str_replace(Location_ID, "_", "-"))

Load in additional data

Load in table with site ids for each of the incubations

Code 
df_sites <- read_xlsx("../Incubations/Incubation_site_location_table.xlsx") %>% 
  rename(Location_ID = Sample_ID)
Code 
df_chem_cambodia <- read_csv("./output/Soil_leaf_grain_all_2025_08_14.csv")

Code 
df_chem_select <- df_chem_cambodia %>% 
  select(Site_ID, Sample_ID, Sampling_campaign, 
         As_Grain, As_Soil, S_Soil, Soil_texture_category, 
         Lat, Long) %>% 
  filter(Site_ID %in% df_sites$Site_ID) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Sampling_campaign, "EXPERIMENTAL")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(As_Grain))
Code 
soil_texture <- df_chem_select %>% 
  select(Site_ID, Soil_texture_category) %>% 
  drop_na()
Code 
df_chem_select <- df_chem_select %>% 
  select(-Soil_texture_category)
Code 
df_chem_select <- df_chem_select %>% 
  left_join(soil_texture)
Joining with `by = join_by(Site_ID)`

EE-44 has Clay/sand soil AEM-06 has Sand/silt soil

Code 
df_chem_select <- df_chem_select %>% 
  mutate(Soil_texture_category = if_else(Site_ID == "EE-44", "Clay/sand", Soil_texture_category)) %>% 
  mutate(Soil_texture_category = if_else(Site_ID == "BET-30", "Clay/sand", Soil_texture_category)) # See our field notebook from 19-June-2025 for the soil texture designation for AEM-19 (BET-30)
Code 
df_chem_summary <- df_chem_select %>% 
  group_by(Site_ID) %>% 
  summarize(As_Grain_mean = mean(As_Grain, na.rm = T),
            As_Grain_max = max(As_Grain, na.rm = T),
            As_Grain_min = min(As_Grain, na.rm = T),
            As_soil_mean = mean(As_Soil, na.rm = T),
            S_soil_mean = mean(S_Soil, na.rm = T),
            Soil_texture_category = first(Soil_texture_category),
            Lat = first(Lat),
            Long = first(Long)
            )

AEM-06 lat/long: 104.762043, 11.926929

Merge incubation data with other lab/field data

Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  left_join(df_sites) %>% 
  left_join(df_chem_summary) %>% 
  mutate(Soil_texture_category = if_else(Site_ID == "AEM-06", "Sand/silt", Soil_texture_category)) %>% 
  
  mutate(Lat = if_else(Site_ID == "AEM-06", 11.926929, Lat),
         Long = if_else(Site_ID == "AEM-06", 104.762043, Long), 
         )
Joining with `by = join_by(Location_ID)`
Joining with `by = join_by(Site_ID)`

texture_levels = c("Clay", "Clay/silt", "Clay/sand", "Sand/silt", "Sand")

df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  mutate(Soil_texture_category = factor(Soil_texture_category, levels = texture_levels, ordered = T))

Load in Nix (Spectral Reflectance) data

Read in Nix data

Code 
df_all <- read_csv(file = "../Analysis/For_Amelia/output/Nix_data_merged.csv")
Rows: 772 Columns: 65
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr (16): original_library_name, saved_collection_name, original_color_name,...
dbl (48): index, observer, L, a, b, c, h, x, y, z, s_rgb_r, s_rgb_g, s_rgb_b...
lgl  (1): density_status

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

Keep only the columns of interest

Code 
df_all <- df_all %>% 
  select(user_color_name, date_saved, sample_id, sample_type, starts_with("r"))

Compute useful derivatives on reflectance data (Updated: 26-Sept-2025)

Code 
df_all <- df_all %>% 
  mutate(slope_590_580 = r590_nm - r580_nm,
         slope_570_560 = r570_nm - r560_nm,
         slope_530_520 = r530_nm - r520_nm
         )

Pivot the data longer

Code 
df_all_long <- df_all %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("r"), names_to = "wavelength", values_to = "reflectance")

Make the wavelength column numeric

Code 
df_all_long <- df_all_long %>% 
  mutate(wavelength = str_remove(wavelength, "r")) %>% 
  mutate(wavelength = str_remove(wavelength, "_nm")) %>% 
  
  mutate(wavelength = as.numeric(wavelength))

Create a summary table of sample means by wavelength (i.e., average duplicate/triplicates)

Code 
df_all_long_summary <- df_all_long %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, sample_type, wavelength) %>% 
  
  summarise(reflectance = mean(reflectance, na.rm = T),
            slope_590_580 = mean(slope_590_580, na.rm = T),
            slope_570_560 = mean(slope_570_560, na.rm = T),
            slope_530_520 = mean(slope_530_520, na.rm = T),
            n_scans = n()
            )
`summarise()` has regrouped the output.
ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by sample_id, sample_type, and wavelength.
ℹ Output is grouped by sample_id and sample_type.
ℹ Use `summarise(.groups = "drop_last")` to silence this message.
ℹ Use `summarise(.by = c(sample_id, sample_type, wavelength))` for
  per-operation grouping (`?dplyr::dplyr_by`) instead.
Code 
df_all_long_summary <- df_all_long_summary %>% 
  rename(Sample_ID = sample_id)
Code 
df_reflectance <- df_all_long_summary %>% 
  filter(wavelength == 400) %>% 
  select(-wavelength, -reflectance, -n_scans) %>% 
  
  rename(Site_ID = Sample_ID)

Join reflectance data to incubation data

Code 
df_incubation <- df_incubation %>% 
  left_join(df_reflectance)
Joining with `by = join_by(Site_ID)`

Summary table

Code 
table_summary_incubations <- df_incubation %>% 
  group_by(Location_ID) %>% 
  summarise(Site_ID = first(Site_ID),
            Soil_texture_category = first(Soil_texture_category), 
            As_inc_max_ppb = round(max(As),1),
            Soil_As_TK__ppb = first(Soil_As_TK__ppb),
            As_Grain_max_ppb = round(first(As_Grain_max)*1000),
            As_Grain_mean_ppb = round(first(As_Grain_mean)*1000),
            As_Grain_min_ppb = round(first(As_Grain_min)*1000), 
            As_soil_mean_ppm = round(first(As_soil_mean), 2), 
            S_soil_mean_ppm = round(first(S_soil_mean), 2), 
            slope_590_580 = first(slope_590_580),
            Lat = first(Lat),
            Long = first(Long)
            
            
            ) %>% 
  arrange(-As_inc_max_ppb)

table_summary_incubations
